part: final-a days 11-15 (Hokkaido: Kutchan, Grand Hirafu, Rusutsu drift, Sapporo, Asahiyama), both flights home, bookFirst items for these days

issues.item: Rusutsu drift: 10:00 slot with 30 min self-drive
issues.problem: The 30-min self-drive (Introduction Course, ¥31,000) runs only at 15:00; at 10:00 you can only book the 4-min ride-along or the 75-min Driving Course (¥61,000).
issues.fix: Ski Hirafu in the morning (return the gear about 12:00), drive to Rusutsu, book the 13:00 ride-along and Pegasis's 15:00 Introduction Course, and drive back to Kutchan about 15:50-16:40. Or keep the morning and book the 10:00 75-min Driving Course (¥61,000) instead.

issues.problem: The Subaru B4 ride-along costs ¥17,000 per person for groups of 1-2 people, not ¥17,000 for both, so the plan's '¥8,500 each' is half the real price.
issues.fix: Use ¥17,000 each (¥34,000 for both). A cheaper option for Aoki: sit in the back seat of Pegasis's Introduction Course for ¥10,000.

issues.problem: The official page asks only for a driver's licence (not needed for the ride-along) and says the instructor can refuse unsafe drivers; it does not say if a foreign licence + IDP or a 1-year licence is accepted.
issues.fix: Keep the email to activity@rusutsu.co.jp before booking. Booking is prepaid, the booking desk is open 08:00-16:00, and a 10% cancellation fee applies from the moment you book, so ask first.

issues.item: Hotel Three M twin room and price
issues.problem: On Jalan, Jan 28-31 is open, but only 2 SMOKING twins remain (no non-smoking twin shown) at ¥70,600 for 3 nights, which is ≈ ¥35,300 per person, not ≈ ¥25,500. Rakuten shows no rooms for these dates.
issues.fix: Add this hotel to bookFirst and book now. If you do not want a smoking room, book the non-smoking single + extra bed plan (¥59,000 for 3 nights, 2 people) or ask the hotel for a non-smoking twin (0136-23-3900).

issues.problem: Jan 29-30 falls in the Peak season (Dec 24 - Feb 28), not Regular Season 1, so Hirafu & Hanazono 1 day costs ¥11,800 online (¥12,500 at the counter) and the afternoon 4-hour pass costs ¥8,400 online (¥8,900).
issues.fix: Change to ¥11,800 (day 11) and ¥8,400 (day 12) per person; online sales are 'in preparation', so buy when they open.

issues.problem: The plan says book the rental in December, but there is a 10% early-bird discount (promo code TGHRental109) only until Oct 31, 2026; that saves ≈ ¥4,300 per person on the ¥42,900 set.
issues.fix: Book both 2-day rental sets online before Oct 31, 2026 with the code. The HIRAFU SNOW group lesson already takes online bookings, so book Aoki's Level 1 lesson (¥10,000, 10:00-12:00, check in by 09:30) at the same time.

issues.problem: No limited express leaves Sapporo at 10:30 on weekdays: they leave at 09:00, 10:00 and 11:00 (the 09:30 Kamui 9 runs only on some days).
issues.fix: Take Lilac 11, Sapporo 10:00 -> Asahikawa 11:25, eat at Hachiya about 11:45, then take bus 41 at about 12:40 (zoo about 13:22). Coming back, the Asahikawa -> Sapporo expresses leave at 16:00, 16:30 and 17:00; plan on the 17:00 (Sapporo about 18:25).

issues.problem: Only the summer timetable (to Nov 3, 2026) is published; the one-way fare is now ¥670 (from Sep 1, 2026). The winter timetable, including the last buses after 15:30, is not published yet.
issues.fix: Check the winter timetable in December. Budget ¥1,340 return per person for the bus.

issues.problem: I could not find the shop's official hours, closed day or exact address (Tabelog blocked; the only sources are Xiaohongshu posts), and Mon Feb 1 is a common closing day for small shops.
issues.fix: Check on Google Maps before the trip, and keep a second soup-curry shop in Susukino as a backup for Monday evening.

issues.problem: The official shop list gives the main shop at Minami 3-jo Higashi 2-chome 6-1, B1F (near Nijo Market), but the plan's pin (43.05805, 141.3551) is about 400 m to the west. You also arrive by car and need a coin car park.
issues.fix: Move the pin to about 43.0584, 141.3590 and add a note: park in a coin car park near Nijo Market. Lunch runs 11:30-15:30, with no fixed closed day ('irregular').

ok: Rusutsu drift season mid-Dec 2026 to late Feb 2027, slots 8:30/10:00/13:00/15:00, book by 17:00 the day before, alcohol check, check-in at the activity desk: https://rusutsu.com/en/winter-activities/snow-driving/
